contradictions: Document claims n8n Data Tables cannot be accessed directly from Code nodes ('must use Data Table node'), but no evidence of whether Code nodes can query via REST API endpoint which is listed as available alternative

Guardrails module lists both 'Check Text for Violations' (route to fail branch) and 'Sanitize Text' (replace inline) as separate operations, but article states 'Limited subset available for Sanitize' (PII, secret keys, URLs, regex only) without explicit confirmation all 9 types support Check operation

System prompt recommends 'keep role high-level' and 'separate tool specifics to tool definition' but also example shows role as 'scheduling assistant for beauty salon' (concrete context), which could be argued as not high-level if applied strictly
Claims 'exact match is stronger than semantic match' for tool names, but no empirical evidence provided; modern LLMs handle semantic equivalence well, so this may be overstated caution

MJ ecosystem argument romanticizes 'no choice but depth' (forced solitude producing genius), but ignores survivorship bias (forced isolation might have broken others, or MJ's genius may have been innate regardless of ecosystem)

Document frames AI consultant density as unsaturated (1 per 14+ businesses), but doesn't account for: (a) geographic clustering (dense in tech hubs, sparse elsewhere), (b) quality/credential variance (not all consultants equivalent), (c) potential commoditization within next 2 years
weird_gold: VAPI function tool parameter types include 'object' (multiple items) and 'array' (e.g. multiple availability dates) without clarity on when to use which; suggests workflows involving calendar availability can pass arrays of dates vs single object structures

Retell's speak-during-execution toggle ('let me check that for you') and speak-after-execution toggle create 3-state UX (silent, speak-during, speak-after) useful for managing user perception of latency during slow tool calls
n8n form customization 'still needs tweaks' suggests ongoing product gaps in visual/UX rendering; using generic form triggers may be safer than heavily customized styling

Average response latency formula for Retell: sum(p10 + p50 + p90) / 3 = simplified metric that averages percentile band vs true distribution (unusual choice; reveals testing methodology preference for p50 focus)

Guardrails 'Topical Alignment' uses LLM-based detection to keep conversation within business scope (e.g. block crypto in SaaS support bot), suggesting meta-prompting to detect off-scope vs keyword list
Data Tables column misnaming creates permanent schema damage (can't rename, only delete/recreate), which is a DX cliff; no column validation step on creation suggests testing-at-deployment risk
